patthana23.40:1.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.40:2.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.40:3.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. nasanidassanattika navipākattike sanidassanattika vipākattikaṃ
